title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure to the network.

entities.name: Paging procedure
entities.description: Network procedure to page a UE for incoming communication.

entities.name: EPS authentication procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure performed during attach for security establishment.

entities.name: Integrity protected message
entities.description: Condition where message has integrity protection applied and verified.

entities.name: Integrity check successful
entities.description: Condition where network successfully verifies message integrity.

entities.name: Paging procedure abort
entities.description: Network behavior to abort ongoing paging procedure.

entities.name: Paging procedure progress
entities.description: Network behavior to continue ongoing paging procedure.

relations.description: ATTACH REQUEST message may have integrity protection condition.
Integrity protected message requires successful integrity check.
Successful integrity check establishes paging procedure abort.
Lack of integrity protection establishes paging procedure progress.
Successful EPS authentication establishes paging procedure abort.
ATTACH REQUEST message may require integrity protection.
